Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear your company team,

You get straight to the quote and then back to the machines—it sounds like you value keeping this straightforward and focused on production. We want a competitive price with delivery arrangements that work in practice. How could flexibility on lead time help you sharpen your price?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,000 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 16.00 per unit (offer:DEMO-C1-0).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 12.51 per unit, 30 days payment, 42 days lead time, DAP). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

thanks for the mail.
we can move a bit:
Our terms: a price of €15.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP.

Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.
Just write if something is unclear.
Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH
